rules: charges are per-instance persisted state and cannot be negative
charge expenditure requires authoritative ownership and sufficient current charges
recharge is disabled unless an authoritative maximum_charges value is projected
consumption quantity must be positive and cannot exceed current stack quantity
consuming the final quantity destroys the runtime instance
non-empty portable containers cannot be consumed or destroyed
all charge and consumption mutations are atomic and roll back on validation failure
classic_unknowns: consumption on failed or interrupted use
